notes.title: Updating logs of Devil's Deck (Ver. 000016)
notes.content:
New DLC [i]Devil’s Deck: Polar Night Falls[/i] is now available!

1.New DLC
New Darkness DLC, including new heroes, cards, items, scrolls and achievements.


2.Cards and relics 
[list]
[*] Relics: Ritual Ring, Pink Coral, Voodoo Pipe;
[*] Wood: Wisp, Goat Rider, Treant Whisperer, Plumed Serpent, Manticore, Emerald Dragon;
[*] Water: Sea Serpent;
[*] Fire: Lava Horse, War Machine, Spiky Hammer, Judge of Abyss, War Elephant, Two-Headed Brute;
[*] Items: Fire Runestone, Voodoo Potion, Handgonne;
[/list]


3.Other
[list]
[*] Added effect to Sleepy Dragon
[*] Added effects to limited damage
[*] Creatures with special abilities can now display normally
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect Titan Amulet effect after upgrading
[*] Fixed incorrect description and effects of Abaddon the War abilities
[*] The damage caused by Dragonlord of Destruction is now rounded down, that is, 1 Blood creature will no longer die after entering the arena.
[*] Dimension Wyrm skills changed
Original Skill: Each time you are about to take damage, if there is a hand, randomly discard a hand and nullify the damage.
Modified: If Dimension Wyrm have cards in hand, reduce any damage it takes by 1.It will shuffle a random card to it's deck.
After leveling up: At the start of it's turn, it draw an extra card.
[*] In the adventure event "enter an inconspicuous temple", "Lose a random card (not visible)" is changed to "Lose a random card (visible)".
[*] Heroes used in the last game will now be first in the selection of heroes
[/list]

notes.title: Updating logs of Devil's Deck (Ver. 000014)
notes.content:
New DLC [i]Devil’s Deck: Astray Destiny[/i] is now available!

We’ll update the game at 15:00 6/30 and that will last about 30 minutes. Here are the details:
1. Bugs Fixed
1) When [i]Wind Whisperer[/i], [i]Soul Assassin[/i], [i]Gill-Cheek Scholar[/i] are up to Rank 14, they will correctly get +60 original gold as other heroes, instead of +6 original gold.
2) Adjusted the text of [i]Vitality Potion[/i] (&[i]Vitality Potion+[/i]) to fit in with its actual effect:
Old:
At the star of each combat, if your HP is blow 50%, restore 20%(40%) of missing Health.
New:
At the star of each combat, if your HP is at or blow 50%, restore 20%(40%) of missing Health.
3) Some other bugs.

2. Game adjustment
1) Adjusted the skill of [i]Master of Camouflage[/i] (Monster of the 2nd Act):
Old: 
Illusion: Whenever an unspawned friendly creauture enters the battlefiled, transmute it into a random enemy creature and trigger its Deplo.
New:
Illusion: (0) Transmute an unspawned friendly creature into a random enemy creature and trigger its Deploy.
2) If your opponent has a [i]Crystal Ball+[/i] or [i]Fiendish Codex+[/i] in hand, now he will use it first.
3) Adjusted some texts:
[i]Conductor of Sea[/i] (Hero)
[i]Quartermaster[/i] (Creature)
[i]Trash Basket[/i] (Relic)

notes.title: Update logs of Devil's Deck(Version 000013)
notes.content:
At 15:00 on March 24, Beijing time, the service will be stopped for 30 minutes, and the following contents will be updated:
[b]BUG[/b]
1、Fixed a bug that no Curse was added to your opponent's deck when Cardback  [Eye of Abyss] was triggered. 

2、Fixed a bug that card [Flame Queen] spawned [Fireball+] before being upgraded.

[b]Change[/b]
1、Hero [Ash Sorcerer]:
Active skill was changed from putting 3 Spells from your Graveyard into your hand to putting 5 Spells from your Graveyard into your hand.
The upgraded card of initial card deck was changed form [Thunderous Beast] to [Fireball].

2、The upgraded skill of [Pegasus Wing] was changed to :Your creatures which enter the battlefield in the first turn of each combat will gain [Charge] and +1 Attack.(Originally, +1 Attack was only for this turn. )

3、The skill of [Wolf Head] was changed to:At the start of each combat, Spawning  [Silverback Wolf] at a random position of yours.([Dire Wolf] was changed to [Silverback Wolf])


4、Skill of card  [Windwalker] was changed to :Whenever a friendly creature is Returned, this launches an extra Attack and gains +1 Attack .
（Original skill was that  whenever a friendly creature is Returned, this gains +2 Attack this turn.）

5、Skill of card  [Mad Pyromancer] was changed to：Take 3 damage and spawn a [Fireball] into your hand.（Original skill was that destroy a friendly creature and spawn a [Fireball] into your hand）

6、Name of card [Two-head Orge] was changed to [Two-Headed Brute],and initial life +1.

notes.title: Update logs of Devil's Deck(Version 000012)
Update logs of Devil's Deck(Version 000011)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The server was maintained at 10:30 Beijing time on December 10.
We will send you 200 magic crystals by mail as compensation.

This version changes these contents:

[list]
[*] Added mail system.
[*] Cut the price of card backs by half.If you have bought the card backs, half of the magic crystals will be returned by mail.
[*] When you play again in battle, the scroll will be returned.

notes.title: Update logs of Devil's Deck(Version 000010)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Sorry for the delay in updating Devil's Deck, which has kept you waiting!
Previous archives (including achievements) cannot continue to be used because the version has changed too much. We have to empty all archives to update. We are very sorry for this!
After the update, the content and quality of the game will change greatly.

[b] Richer content: [/b]
[list]
[*] number of cards: increased from more than 240 to more than 340;
[*] adventure items: increased from more than 70 to more than 110;
[*] number of achievements: increased from more than 60 to more than 130;
[*] number of Heroes: increased from 3 to 12:
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35110969/6a6396daf4a392ee974d1f806a96d36c2873a589.jpg[/img]

[b] More functions: [/b]
[list]
[*] add a new game mode: "Nightmare mode".
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35110969/32e64dd62d3bbf90db5449b17619f70843b74719.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Function of querying battle records;
[*]Function of replacing card back;
[*] Function of training Heroes;
[*] Function of scrolls;
[*] More leaderboards。
[/list]

[b] Better art: [/b]
[list]
[*] The new version redoes all special effects and adds special effects to each spell.
[*] All UI have been redone in the new version. The style is the same as before, but more exquisite.
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35110969/ea991619abbf9ca7d377a70068636f9bfb462c29.jpg[/img]

[b] Redo values: [/b]
Most of the values have been redone in the new version.
We think the balance will be better than the old version.

[b] Description of server temporary shutdown: [/b]
We need to shut down the server for about a week for preliminary testing. Please wait a few more days.

[b] Store Description: [/b]
Devil's deck's store page will be inaccessible in the coming months.
But you can play the game normally, and we will update it continuously.
When the game can be officially launched, the store page will open again.

We hope the new version will bring you more happiness!
Thanks!

notes.title: Update logs of Devil’s Deck (version 000007)
Update logs of Devil’s Deck (version 000006)（中文在后面）
Main changes which have been made in game so far:
notes.content:
1. Increase the number of days between enemies from 4 days to 5, totally from 16 to 20 for each floor (problem: it was  too hasty to meet an enemy for every 4 steps).
2. The initial Max Mana of both sides takes1 instead of 0 (problem: it was a little boring because there was barely nothing else to do at the start of each combat).
3. Increased a Fast mode which can speed up the animation (problem: a combat took too long because of the animation).
4. You can use a more powerful hero skill once in each combat, rather than a mini one in a single turn. (problem: hero skills seemed to be weak, especially compared with ones of your opponents').
5. All decks of heros has been greatly improved. We decrease the number of non-effect cards and improve remaining non-effect cards. Besides, many powerful cards have been added into initial decks. (problem: the initial deck is too weak).
6. Now you can gain more benefits in each event. (problem: you gained so little in events that your deck was not good enough to fight against enemies. It is difficult to complete a game).
7. Lower the degrees of difficulty of all levels (problem: it was difficult to have fun).
8. Adjust the values of many cards (problem: the balance among cards).[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35110969/44743c9784f516e0491f7c3d6e4135522413c408.jpg[/img]
